title: Stage 1 Visual Syntax Analysis
description: SKILL.md §2, §6. Interpretation layer — built from observation.schema.json objects, never invented independently of them. slide_role and primitive_type values are validated against contracts/taxonomy_bindings.json (Regression Case 1). syntax_hash, not layout_fingerprint, is the authoritative identity used for deduplication.

evidence_refs.description: Overall evidence links for slide_role, resolving to observation.schema.json object_ids. Empty array is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (invariants.json).

layout_fingerprint.description: Human-readable only. Max ~8 words per the existing prompt constraint. NOT used for deduplication identity.

syntax_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonicalized {slide_role, container_zones (sorted), primitives (sorted by type+zone), normalized geometry, anchor_elements (sorted by label)}. Authoritative identity for deduplication — see SKILL.md §6 and Regression Case 4.

then.description: A NOVEL_CANDIDATE slide_role must additionally satisfy taxonomy_candidate.schema.json for the same proposed name — see SKILL.md §4.
